findings.resolution: The public wrapper is executable only by service_role, the failpoint-bearing internal function is unavailable to service_role, and both functions use an empty search_path with qualified objects.

The transfer accepts only App Store sandbox events, requires an existing provider-backed source and exact non-authority mapping, writes zero-amount non-payable ledger effects, and grants no payout or LiveKit authority.
Edge audit data contains event hashes and boolean outcomes rather than source/target user IDs or raw payloads; fixtures are synthetic and contain no credential-shaped values.

Event/user advisory locks, identity-matched duplicate recognition, a single database transaction, and failpoint rollback protect duplicate and partial-failure handling apart from the separate chronological-order P1.
Refund, revocation, expiration, cancellation, and pause events remain routable through the existing terminal-event policy while new purchases remain switch-controlled.
